subject: Mythology
title: Egyptology: Uncovering the Truth
description: A quick win: understand Egyptology: Uncovering the Truth.

hook.text: Egyptology began as treasure hunting but became one of the most rigorous sciences in modern archaeology.

buildup.text: Early explorers like Giovanni Belzoni used dynamite to open tombs, destroying priceless artifacts in the process.

discovery.text: Howard Carter's careful excavation of Tutankhamun's tomb in 1922 set new standards for archaeological method.

twist.text: CT scans and DNA analysis now reveal secrets from mummies without unwrapping them, using twenty-first-century tools.

climax.text: We now know what diseases pharaohs had, what they ate, and even what their faces looked like in life.

punchline.text: Modern science asks questions the pharaohs never imagined anyone would ask.

quiz.question: What modern technology helps study mummies without unwrapping them?
